lines.zh: 我背上那顶菌盖跟着脚步晃。
lines.en: The cap on my back sways with every step.

lines.zh: 我走路不快，但每一步都朝着你。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step heads for you.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进腐叶里，拔出来继续走。
lines.en: My feet sink into rotten leaves; I pull them out and go on.

lines.zh: 菌丝从脚底伸出去，替我探路。
lines.en: Mycelium reaches out from my soles and scouts ahead.

lines.zh: 秘境的地面软，我踩下去没有声。
lines.en: Mysterium's ground is soft, so my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我驮着自己的菌盖，走了很久。
lines.en: I have carried my own cap a long way.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，撞到树就推开它。
lines.en: I do not detour; if a tree is in the way I shove it.

lines.zh: 走过的地上会留下一层白丝。
lines.en: A layer of white threads marks where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在秤自己的重量。
lines.en: I pace as if weighing myself with each step.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，我从不停下。
lines.en: Do not mistake slow for stopping; I never stop.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体宽，因为那顶盖。
lines.en: My shadow is wider than my body, thanks to the cap.

lines.zh: 我朝你走来，路线简单得可怕。
lines.en: I walk at you, and my route is frighteningly simple.

lines.zh: 我站着不动时，鸟会落在我盖上。
lines.en: When I stand still, birds land on my cap.

lines.zh: 背上的菌盖越来越重，压得我低头。
lines.en: The cap grows heavier and presses my head down.

lines.zh: 我靠着一棵树，把菌丝扎进土里。
lines.en: I lean on a tree and sink my threads into the soil.

lines.zh: 秘境的紫光晒久了，盖会发烫。
lines.en: Long in Mysterium's violet light, my cap turns hot.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，让菌褶里的孢子出来。
lines.en: I breathe slowly and let spores out of my gills.

lines.zh: 我什么都不想，只想下一顿。
lines.en: I think of nothing except the next meal.

lines.zh: 有虫子在我盖上爬，我懒得动。
lines.en: Insects crawl on my cap and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在听地下的菌丝说话。
lines.en: I listen to the mycelium talking underground.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚下会冒出小小的白点。
lines.en: Stand long enough and little white points rise at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把重心前后挪，试着不那么累。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward and back, trying to rest.

lines.zh: 我的盖在夜里会微微发光。
lines.en: My cap glows faintly in the night.

lines.zh: 我等风，也等有人走近。
lines.en: I wait for wind, and for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 树影挪一寸，我就跟着挪一寸。
lines.en: The shade moves an inch and I move with it.

lines.zh: 这一片地我站了三天，没人来。
lines.en: I have held this patch three days and nobody came.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把孢子抖进空气里。
lines.en: I shake my spores slowly into the air.

lines.zh: 菌盖边上裂了一道，不疼。
lines.en: A crack runs along my cap; it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 我听着秘境的风，像有人在低语。
lines.en: I listen to the Mysterium wind, like whispering.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我焐得有点温。
lines.en: The soil under me has warmed from my standing.

lines.zh: 你比树矮，比虫子大，正好。
lines.en: Shorter than a tree, bigger than a bug; perfect.

lines.zh: 我抬起盖，让眼睛从阴影里露出来。
lines.en: I lift my cap so my eyes come out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我在看你的膝盖，那里最容易撞。
lines.en: I am watching your knees; that is where I strike best.

lines.zh: 你站着，我算着你离我几步。
lines.en: You stand there, and I count the steps between us.

lines.zh: 别躲到树后，我的菌丝能闻到。
lines.en: Do not hide behind a tree; my threads can smell you.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久，你才刚发现。
lines.en: I had been staring at you long before you turned.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底沾了孢子，那是我的。
lines.en: Spores on your soles are mine.

lines.zh: 我歪一歪盖，把视线对准你的腰。
lines.en: I tilt my cap and line my gaze up with your waist.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，我不认识。
lines.en: That sword in your hand is nothing I know.

lines.zh: 你一后退，我就知道该怎么走了。
lines.en: You step back once, and I know exactly how to walk.

lines.zh: 我背上的盖在动，那是风，不是我。
lines.en: My cap moves in the wind; that is not me moving.

lines.zh: 你走过来的味道，我闻得一清二楚。
lines.en: The smell of you walking over reaches me clearly.

lines.zh: 菌盖被砍开，里面全是白丝。
lines.en: My cap is cut open, and white threads fill it.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚却拔不出来。
lines.en: I step back, but my foot will not come free.

lines.zh: 疼，我的盖也跟着抖。
lines.en: It hurts, and my cap shakes with it.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方，明天会长出新的。
lines.en: What you cut will grow back by tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我发出低低的咕噜声。
lines.en: I let out a low, gurgling sound.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我还走得动。
lines.en: This wound will not stop me walking.

lines.zh: 我的盖裂了，但根还在土里。
lines.en: My cap is split, but my roots stay in the soil.

lines.zh: 你打我，我就更想压你。
lines.en: The more you hit me, the more I want to crush you.

lines.zh: 孢子从伤口里涌出来，像在流血。
lines.en: Spores pour from the wound as if I were bleeding.

lines.zh: 我慢，可我不会倒。
lines.en: I am slow, but I do not fall.

lines.zh: 你手里的腐肉，我可以考虑。
lines.en: The rotten meat in your hand is worth considering.

lines.zh: 我不吃亮闪闪的东西，只吃软的。
lines.en: I do not eat shiny things, only soft ones.

lines.zh: 你把食物放低，我就当是给我的。
lines.en: Lower the food and I will treat it as mine.

lines.zh: 我背上的盖也在闻，它比我先动。
lines.en: The cap on my back smells it too, and moves first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，不是馋，是习惯。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, not from greed but from habit.

lines.zh: 拿远一点，我不喜欢别人喂我。
lines.en: Hold it farther away; I dislike being fed.

lines.zh: 那块东西烂得正好，你懂行。
lines.en: That thing is rotted just right; you know your trade.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是那点食物。
lines.en: I am watching your hand, not the morsel in it.

lines.zh: 你举着它退后，我就跟上去。
lines.en: Hold it up and back away, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我等它掉在地上，那样才算我的。
lines.en: I wait for it to hit the ground; then it counts as mine.

lines.zh: 我撞上来的时候，菌盖先顶到你。
lines.en: When I collide, my cap reaches you first.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我停不住，我的腿太短。
lines.en: Sorry, I cannot stop; my legs are too short.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我的盖才没有压下来。
lines.en: You step back and my cap does not come down on you.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，孢子被挤了出来。
lines.en: We squeeze together and the spores are pressed out.

lines.zh: 我一撞就歪，得靠树才站直。
lines.en: One bump and I lean; only a tree straightens me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的菌丝了，很疼。
lines.en: You stepped on my mycelium, and that hurts.

lines.zh: 我顶着你往前走，这是本能。
lines.en: I push forward against you; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的盖掉了一小角。
lines.en: The impact cost my cap a small corner.

lines.zh: 别推我的背，那里是我全部的家当。
lines.en: Do not push my back; everything I own is there.

lines.zh: 我背上的菌盖比石头还硬。
lines.en: The fungus on my back is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 两顶菌盖贴在一起，会长出新的丝。
lines.en: Two caps pressed together grow new threads.

lines.zh: 我不挑，谁背上的盖大就听谁的。
lines.en: I am not choosy; whoever carries the bigger cap leads.

lines.zh: 秘境的地面上，我们排成一排。
lines.en: On Mysterium's ground we line up in a row.

lines.zh: 孢子在我脚下积成一小片白。
lines.en: Spores gather at my feet in a small white patch.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只是慢慢靠近。
lines.en: We say nothing and simply draw nearer.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣比我矮，盖却更圆。
lines.en: My mate is shorter than me but has a rounder cap.

lines.zh: 分开之后，菌丝还连着好几天。
lines.en: After we part, our threads stay joined for days.

lines.zh: 这是安静的事，别在旁边看。
lines.en: This is a quiet matter; do not stand and watch.

lines.zh: 我们把菌丝缠在一起过冬。
lines.en: We twine our threads together to last the winter.

lines.zh: 下一代会长在离我很近的地方。
lines.en: The next generation will grow close to where I stand.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，捡起来又掉了。
lines.en: I bend slowly, pick it up, and drop it again.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我用脚拨，不用手。
lines.en: I nudge things on the ground with my feet, not my hands.

lines.zh: 那块骨头太滑，我试了三次。
lines.en: That bone is too smooth; I tried three times.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西塞进菌盖下面。
lines.en: I stuff what I find beneath my cap.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，我不弯第二次腰。
lines.en: What falls, falls; I will not stoop twice.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢捡腐烂的、软的。
lines.en: I prefer to pick up what is rotten and soft.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your dropped item clattered, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我踩过一个东西，它碎了。
lines.en: I stepped on something and it broke.

lines.zh: 我不捡宝贝，菌盖已经够重。
lines.en: I collect no treasure; my cap is heavy enough.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到脚边，我就踢开。
lines.en: When something rolls to my feet, I kick it away.

lines.zh: 我看见你在林子里停了两次。
lines.en: I saw you stop twice inside the wood.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别人都跑得太快。
lines.en: The target is you; the others run too fast.

lines.zh: 我的菌丝已经朝你那个方向伸了。
lines.en: My threads already reach toward where you are.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝条，替我标好了位置。
lines.en: The branch you broke marks your position for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把盖朝向你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and point my cap at you.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，我只走这一条线。
lines.en: From this moment I walk one line only.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，把雾推开了一圈。
lines.en: Your warmth pushes the fog back in a ring.

lines.zh: 就是现在，我闻到你离我很近。
lines.en: Now, when I can smell how near you are.

lines.zh: 别跑，我虽然慢，但我不迷路。
lines.en: Do not run; I am slow but I never lose the way.

lines.zh: 我选定的路，不会拐弯。
lines.en: The path I pick does not bend aside.

lines.zh: 我一步、一步地缩短距离。
lines.en: One step, then another, and the gap closes.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就多走两步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I take two steps more.

lines.zh: 我压低头，让菌盖挡住我的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head and let my cap hide my face.

lines.zh: 你绕树，我也绕，只是绕得更大。
lines.en: You circle the tree, and I circle wider.

lines.zh: 我不用想角度，我只要贴上去。
lines.en: I need no angle; I only need to close in.

lines.zh: 我听见你在喘，这很好。
lines.en: I hear you breathing hard, and that is good.

lines.zh: 菌丝在地上铺开，你踩上去会慢。
lines.en: My threads spread on the ground and will slow your feet.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我学了三天。
lines.en: I have studied how you raise that shield for three days.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的盖就能压到你。
lines.en: A little closer and my cap can press you down.

lines.zh: 我不催自己，等你先累。
lines.en: I will not hurry; let yourself tire first.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体撞过去，八点五。
lines.en: I throw my whole body in, eight and a half.

lines.zh: 菌盖压在你胸口，孢子全进了你鼻子。
lines.en: My cap presses your chest and spores fill your nose.

lines.zh: 你被撞退，我的脚还钉在原地。
lines.en: You are knocked back while my feet stay planted.

lines.zh: 这一下不快，但你躲不开。
lines.en: It is not fast, but you cannot dodge it.

lines.zh: 我撞完不退，反而再顶一下。
lines.en: I do not recoil; I push again instead.

lines.zh: 我的前肢短，只能用体重。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short, so I use my weight.

lines.zh: 你挡住的只是我的盖，不是我。
lines.en: You blocked my cap, not me.

lines.zh: 青苔被我们踩烂了，味道很重。
lines.en: We crush the moss underfoot and the smell is thick.

lines.zh: 别指望我喘，我没有肺。
lines.en: Do not expect me to pant; I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 你退到树边，那就没地方退了。
lines.en: You back to the tree, and there is no room left.

lines.zh: 我从腐叶下面拱出来，盖先露。
lines.en: I push up through the rotten leaves, cap first.

lines.zh: 秘境多了一个背蘑菇的。
lines.en: Mysterium gains one more mushroom-backed thing.

lines.zh: 我出生时，菌丝就已经很长了。
lines.en: When I was born my threads were already long.

lines.zh: 地面很软，正合我的脚。
lines.en: The ground is soft, exactly right for my feet.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的土，慢慢站直。
lines.en: I shake off the soil and straighten up slowly.

lines.zh: 四周的树太高，我抬头看了很久。
lines.en: The trees are so tall that I stare upward a while.

lines.zh: 我的第一件事，是找一块能站的地。
lines.en: My first task is to find ground I can stand on.

lines.zh: 雾还没散，我先在原地等。
lines.en: The fog has not lifted, so I wait where I am.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我听见了脚步。
lines.en: Someone is nearby; I heard the footsteps.

lines.zh: 这顶盖会越长越大，压弯我的背。
lines.en: This cap will grow until it bends my back.

lines.zh: 我从一株倒下的树里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of a fallen tree.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是长得像朵蘑菇。
lines.en: Do not be afraid; I only look like a mushroom.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖烧起来，味道很熟。
lines.en: My cap catches fire and the smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，盖先着地。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my cap lands first.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌褶，我变得很重。
lines.en: Water fills my gills and I become heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast tips me over with my legs in the air.

lines.zh: 箭钉在菌盖上，像一根新长的枝。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my cap like a new-grown branch.

lines.zh: 法术让我的菌丝一齐缩回土里。
lines.en: The spell pulls all my threads back into the soil.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，连土都嚼。
lines.en: When I am hungry I even chew the soil.

lines.zh: 雷落在我盖上，白丝全竖了起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits my cap and every white thread stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，菌丝却抓不到东西。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and my threads grip nothing.
